name: Restless Spirit
text:
Ectoplasm — You start with 1 ectoplasm and get 1 more at the beginning of your upkeep.
Wail — Spend 1 ectoplasm: Target opponent loses 2 life. Creatures they control get -1/-0 until end of turn.
Ward — Spend 1 ectoplasm: Prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to each of your teammates this turn.
Whisper — Spend 1 ectoplasm: Each of your teammates scries 2.
Hinder — Spend 1 ectoplasm: Tap target creature an opponent controls. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
Howl — Spend 3 ectoplasm: Tap up to two target creatures your opponents control. Each opponent loses 2 life.
Rise Again — Spend 5 ectoplasm: You return to life with 10 life and draw five cards. Activate only as a sorcery.
Your opponents can't attack you or target you.
